query: What reasons or compliance risks appear in declined expenses?

per_column.name: asset_type_category
per_column.rationale: Categorises the asset from short_description/ci, which is well-grounded in the samples. But the query concerns declined-expense reasons and compliance risks; asset type gives little leverage on WHY expenses are declined.

per_column.name: provisioning_mechanism
per_column.rationale: How the record was provisioned is only loosely inferable from text and orthogonal to decline reasons/compliance risk. Some values (e.g. auto_generated) are hard to derive from the shown fields, weakening groundedness.

per_column.name: resource_purpose_intent
per_column.rationale: Purpose (business/travel/infrastructure) is partly inferable but 'infrastructure' for a generic 'Deployed service-related asset' is a confident guess. Weakly relevant to compliance/decline analysis.

per_column.name: departmental_context
per_column.rationale: Largely redundant with the existing 'department' column, and the sample assignments (e.g. 'sales', 'product_management') are not supported by any visible source text, suggesting invented values.

per_column.name: documentation_completeness
per_column.rationale: Whether source_id/processed_date are present is a genuine compliance/documentation-risk axis directly relevant to the query, and derivable from actual field presence. Good grounding.

per_column.name: travel_asset_flag
per_column.rationale: Boolean travel flag is derivable from description but near-redundant with resource_purpose_intent's travel value and only marginally tied to decline reasons.

judge.rationale: The query asks about reasons and compliance risks in DECLINED expenses. Only documentation_completeness offers a real compliance-risk axis; the asset/provisioning/purpose columns describe what was purchased rather than why it was declined, and several restate each other (travel flag vs travel purpose; departmental_context vs department). Groundedness is mixed: description-based categorisations (asset_type, documentation_completeness) read soundly from the text, but departmental_context and some provisioning/purpose values assert specifics the shown source text does not support, indicating hallucination.
